temporal_encoders.none: frames independent; emissions are per-frame CNN outputs
temporal_encoders.transformer: nn.TransformerEncoder, 8 heads, ff 4*256, dropout 0.1, sinusoidal positional encoding
temporal_encoders.mstcn: MS-TCN, emits class logits directly, per-stage auxiliary losses
temporal_encoders.asformer: ASFormer, same slot and loss structure as mstcn
